item.title: Participated at the AI for Good Global Summit in Geneva, Switzerland
item.description:
Just returned from my first AI for Good Global Summit in Geneva — an incredible experience!

I was especially inspired by the focus on AI in healthcare:

  • Reversing diabetes and Parkinson’s with AI-powered stem cell therapies
  • Real-time, personalized health risk screening using AI
  • Tackling global health inequities with open, responsible, and equitable AI solutions

This summit reminded me that AI is not just about innovation — it’s about impact. Excited to keep learning and contributing to this global movement
